scoring_justification: Dipole fraction and total intensities can be recomputed from the agent's raw spectrum arrays; ground state symmetry is extracted, and intensity ordering is checked against the paper's reported trend.

required.O_h: object containing energy, total_intensity, dipole_intensity, quadrupole_intensity (arrays of floats) and ground_state_symmetry (string)

outputs.description: Raw LFM pre-edge spectra with separate dipole and quadrupole components for the four symmetries. The checker will integrate the intensities to compute dipole contribution fractions, verify ground state symmetries, and confirm total intensity ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold dipole fractions and ground state symmetries from Table I
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table I: Dipole contribution (%) column and Ground state symmetry column
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are exactly those reported in the paper
